STANDARD_INDUSTRIAL.name: Standard Industrial Plant Profile
STANDARD_INDUSTRIAL.description: Balanced sensitivity profile suitable for regular benchtop validation and testing.

NORMAL_OPERATION.description: System operating within all expected tolerances and timing constraints.

SETPOINT_DEVIATION.description: Actuator or measured sensor response deviates from target setpoint beyond configured tolerance band.
SETPOINT_DEVIATION.recommended_action: Check setpoint appropriateness, inspect actuator mechanical linkage, verify sensor calibration.

ACTUATOR_RESPONSE_FAILURE.description: Actuator failed to begin moving or change state within the acceptable time window after setpoint command.
ACTUATOR_RESPONSE_FAILURE.recommended_action: Inspect L293D motor driver power supply (LM2596 buck converter 5V rail), motor wiring, and servo mechanical obstruction.

SENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: Physical sensor measurement falls outside realistic or safe operating boundaries.
SENSOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.recommended_action: Verify environmental temperature is within bounds, check if obstacle is closer than 2 cm deadband or beyond ultrasonic 400 cm range.

SENSOR_DISCONNECTED_OR_INVALID.description: Sensor output is floating, pinned to power rail (0V or 3.3V), or failing to respond (echo timeout).
SENSOR_DISCONNECTED_OR_INVALID.recommended_action: Check BSS138 level shifter wiring for HC-SR04, verify LM35 ground and VCC pins, inspect ADC jumper on PA0.

COMMUNICATION_TIMEOUT.description: Heartbeat or telemetry packet lost between Node 1 and Node 2, or between Host and Node 1.
COMMUNICATION_TIMEOUT.recommended_action: Verify inter-node UART jumper wires (Node 1 PA9 to Node 2 PA10, Node 1 PA10 to Node 2 PA9, Common GND), check USB cable connection.

UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE.description: Actuator motion opposite to commanded direction or rapid erratic oscillation detected.
UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE.recommended_action: Check L293D IN1/IN2 polarity wiring, check for electrical noise coupling on servo control wire.

EMERGENCY_STOP.description: Emergency stop line pulled or manual software abort invoked. Actuators forcibly de-energized.
EMERGENCY_STOP.recommended_action: Clear physical hazard, press Reset Faults on dashboard, and re-arm test sequence.

EQ_15_09_PENDING.description: Refer to eq15_09_condition.json. Pending engineering specification.
EQ_15_09_PENDING.recommended_action: Review specification document EQ-15-09 when released.

SENSITIVE_BENCH.name: High Sensitivity Validation Profile
SENSITIVE_BENCH.description: Tighter tolerances for laboratory qualification and calibration.

SETPOINT_DEVIATION.recommended_action: Calibrate sensors and tune PWM PID/control parameters.

ACTUATOR_RESPONSE_FAILURE.recommended_action: Inspect mechanical friction and battery voltage.
